label: Finite support sidecar cardinality (thread derived)
family: V · FADT / quotient and decision preservation

record.category: V · FADT / quotient and decision preservation
record.description: For quotient fibres whose antecedents induce r_y distinct support sets, a sidecar distinguishing those supports needs at least max_y r_y labels; fixed-width binary encoding needs ceil(log2(max_y r_y)) bits. This is a direct combinatorial result discussed in-thread, requiring separate archival proof/context before publication.
